news.headline: Analysts cut price targets after Q2 revenue miss and guidance reduction
news.summary: Stifel lowered its CLPT price target to $22 from $25 and Lake Street cut its target to $25 from $30, both maintaining Buy ratings, after ClearPoint's Q2 revenue miss and lowered FY26 guidance; the stock had fallen roughly 15% after hours on August 3.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro reports Q2 2026 revenue miss, cuts full-year guidance to $48M-$52M
news.summary: Q2 revenue was $10.9 million (+18% YoY) but about $1.8 million below the $12.7 million consensus, with EPS of -$0.38 versus -$0.29 expected; the company lowered 2026 revenue guidance to $48M-$52M from $52M-$56M and ended the quarter with $29.4 million in cash, down from $45.9 million at year-end 2025. Shares dropped roughly 15% in after-hours trading.

news.headline: Company unveils long-term $500 million revenue target and five-pillar growth strategy
news.summary: Alongside the Q2 miss, management presented a strategic plan targeting $500 million in annual revenue built around cell/gene therapy delivery, citing 60+ active biopharma partners, a reorganized commercial structure, and roughly 10 anticipated clinical data readouts over the next 18 months.

news.headline: Partner Aspen Neuroscience receives FDA RMAT designation for Parkinson's cell therapy delivered via ClearPoint system
news.summary: The FDA granted Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) designation to Aspen Neuroscience's sasineprocel (ANPD001), an autologous dopaminergic neuron therapy for Parkinson's disease delivered using ClearPoint's navigation technology, potentially speeding its path toward approval.

news.headline: EpilepsyGTx partners with ClearPoint Neuro to deliver gene therapy EPY201 in first-in-human epilepsy trial
news.summary: UK biotech EpilepsyGTx will use ClearPoint's SmartFlow Cannula and Neuro Navigation System for MRI-guided delivery of its investigational gene therapy EPY201 in an upcoming Phase I/IIa trial for focal refractory epilepsy, adding another biopharma partner to ClearPoint's delivery ecosystem.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly report; investors will watch whether the Biologics and Drug Delivery segment returns to growth as guided (aided by the newly acquired ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories facility) and whether full-year guidance of $48M-$52M holds.

catalysts.label: ~10 clinical data readouts from biopharma partners
catalysts.detail: Management guided to roughly 10 partner data readouts and 10-15 enrolling clinical trials using ClearPoint delivery systems over the next 18 months, spanning partners such as AskBio, BlueRock, Kenai Therapeutics, REGENXBIO, AviadoBio, Neurona, PTC Therapeutics, Siren Biotechnology, uniQure, EpilepsyGTx and Aspen Neuroscience.

catalysts.label: CE Mark for 3.x navigation software and iCT upgrades
catalysts.detail: Company roadmap targets CE Mark clearance for its 3.x software version and iCT compatibility upgrades to its navigation platform during 2026, ahead of Harmony 1.0 sub-nuclei segmentation targeted for 2027.

catalysts.label: Aspen Neuroscience potential BLA / accelerated pathway progress
catalysts.detail: RMAT designation for sasineprocel gives Aspen more frequent FDA interaction and potential eligibility for priority/accelerated review; any BLA filing or additional FDA feedback would be a catalyst for ClearPoint's co-delivery role.

catalysts.label: Long-term $500M revenue strategy execution
catalysts.detail: Management's five-pillar plan (device sales, biologics/drug delivery services, capital equipment, focused ultrasound, and robotics) aims at $500M annual revenue longer-term; execution updates typically come each quarterly call.

catalysts.label: Focused ultrasound partnership milestones with Sungkyunkwan University (SONOCARE Lab)
catalysts.detail: Preclinical blood-brain-barrier tracer delivery results were already reported; further preclinical/clinical progress under this 10-year focused ultrasound development partnership is a watch item for entering that market.

pulse: ClearPoint Neuro's stock has been under pressure since its August 3, 2026 Q2 report, which missed revenue and EPS estimates and forced a cut to full-year guidance ($48M-$52M from $52M-$56M), triggering analyst price-target reductions (Stifel to $22, Lake Street to $25) even as both kept Buy ratings. Despite the near-term miss, the long-term bull case remains intact: management unveiled a $500M revenue ambition built on its expanding biopharma partner ecosystem (60+ partners), and partners continue to hit regulatory milestones, including Aspen Neuroscience's FDA RMAT designation (July 31) and a new EpilepsyGTx delivery partnership (mid-July). As of August 21, 2026, CLPT trades well off its 52-week high near $30, with the next major catalyst being Q3 2026 earnings and the roughly 10 partner clinical data readouts management guided to over the next 18 months.
